messages:
alex: Heads up — noticed 3 users got re-granted admin role after last night's SCIM backfill. Audit shows a deprovision entry earlier today but then a backfill upsert.
provisioner-bot: Backfill job completed: job_id=bf-2026-03-19-02 processed=2484 errors=0 schema_version=3
maria: :eyes: can you paste the relevant audit lines?
alex: Logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-19T01:12:05Z USER_CHANGE user=urn:extid:acme:123 action=deprovision actor=provisioner-service
2026-03-19T02:03:22Z USER_CHANGE user=urn:extid:acme:123 action=provision actor=backfill job=bf-2026-03-19-02 attrs={"tombstone":false}
```
jordan: Is that the run with --repair-missing-members enabled? We toggled that flag for the tenant migration.
alex: Yes, provisioner v2.7.1 (commit abc123) with --repair-missing-members. I expected tombstoned users to be skipped.
samir: Hypothesis: backfill upsert ignores tombstone marker when repair flag active, effectively re-adding members from authoritative list.
maria: Can someone check KMS decrypt logs? If the provisioner failed to read tombstone metadata from encrypted store it might fall back.
alex: KMS calls succeeded. The SCIM payload we got for the authoritative group lacked "tombstone": true; seems the backfill source had stale membership.
jordan: So flow may be: deprov -> tombstone mark in local DB -> external source still lists user -> backfill overwrites to active.
samir: Short-term mitigation: revoke admin role for affected users and add exclusion to backfill for tenant `acme`.
alex: I'll run manual revoke: PATCH /api/rbac/users/urn:extid:acme:123 {"roles": []} and open rollback PR to revert leaked role changes. Filed ticket INFR-4321.
provisioner-bot: Scheduled: dry-run bf-validate-237123 at 2026-03-19T09:00Z
maria: Also enable PROV_AUDIT_LEVEL=full for next runs and add a validation step that ensures tombstone attr blocks upsert.
jordan: Root-cause hypothesis: backfill code path in repair mode uses upsert_user(ext_id, attrs) and doesn't check attrs.tombstone. I'll prepare a patch to short-circuit when tombstone==true and add unit/integration tests.
samir: Assign to @jordan and cc eng-security; add a test that reproduces deprov+backfill race.
alex: Can ops revoke the KMS grant used by the backfill role until we deploy a fix?
ops-oncall: Oncall here — revoking temporary grant for provisioner-bf now.
ops-oncall: Done — KMS grant revoked (grant_id=g-9876). Noted in INFR-4321.
maria: :thumbsup: Once patch is in, let's run a validated backfill with --validate-only and re-run audits. We'll track in postmortems channel.
